name: Zeynîzâde Hüseyin Efendi
summary: Ottoman grammarian who wrote the word-by-word iʿrāb of the madrasa's naḥw books, Birgivī's al-ʿAwāmil and Iẓhār al-asrār and Ibn al-Ḥājib's al-Kāfiya.
bio: Zeynîzâde Hüseyin Efendi is known through his books: he wrote muʿrib works, which take a text of grammar and give the iʿrāb of each of its words, for the three naḥw books of the Ottoman madrasa: Birgivī's al-ʿAwāmil, Birgivī's Iẓhār al-asrār (Ḥall asrār al-akhyār ʿalā iʿrāb Iẓhār al-asrār) and Ibn al-Ḥājib's al-Kāfiya. Students used them to check their own analysis, and they were printed many times in Istanbul.

works.title: Ḥall asrār al-akhyār ʿalā iʿrāb Iẓhār al-asrār
works.arabic: حَلُّ أَسْرَارِ الأَخْيَارِ عَلَى إِعْرَابِ إِظْهَارِ الأَسْرَار

uncertain: Little is known of his life; the TDV gives his death as 1172/1759 with a question mark.
